findings.statement: The primary onboarding API endpoint is POST /api/onboard/text, called when users submit their contact information to talk with Boardy. The request sends JSON containing email, phone, honeypot website field, UTM parameters, and intent, and returns a verified phone number, pre-filled SMS body text, and a QR code data URL.

The homepage dynamically polls GET /api/public-globe using fetch with an AbortController (8-second timeout) and IntersectionObserver when the globe is visible. The response supplies recent introduction metrics and geographical coordinate routes used to animate the interactive globe.

Third-party analytics and integration calls include PostHog (feature flags, surveys, product tours, experiment tokens), Sentry monitoring, and marketing attribution pixels. Scheduling interactions route to the dedicated cal.boardy.ai service for booking pages and calendar synchronization.

handoff: Fetched missing video posters (cc-boardy-text-reschedule-poster.webp and public-link-bouncer-poster.webp) for /booking, removed the injected <script> tag from HTML heads that caused React hydration mismatches (error #418), moved the mock and error suppression listener into the top of the main bundle, and rebuilt app/dist via npm run build.
